title: Panel-by-Panel Comic & Manga Reader | Sutra
description: Read comics and manga panel by panel with Sutra on iPhone and Android. Learn about formats, free previews, Pro access, and reading limitations.
h1: Read comics and manga one panel at a time
intro: Sutra is an iOS and Android reader for your own supported DRM-free books and comics. Panel Mode can move through detected panels one at a time, with right-to-left manga reading on supported content.
benefits: Switch between a full-page view and panel-by-panel reading when supported panels are detected.
Use right-to-left reading order for manga on supported content.
Read EPUB and PDF for free; full CBZ and DRM-free MOBI require Pro.
compatibility: Limited preview may be available; full reading · Pro
Limited preview may be available; full reading · Pro
Preview details vary; full reading · Pro
Preview details vary; full reading · Pro
steps: Open a supported comic or manga file from a connected catalog or import a file you are entitled to read.
The reader opens on the full page. Use the Panel Mode control to switch to panel-by-panel reading.
Choose right-to-left manga reading when appropriate for the work.
For CBZ and comic-shaped MOBI files, try the available preview; full reading requires Sutra Pro.
limitations: Panel detection is not guaranteed to identify every panel or every page correctly. Pages without detected panels remain readable as full pages.
Full CBZ and DRM-free MOBI reading require Pro; the limited preview does not make the full format free.
CBR archives and DRM-protected purchases are not supported.

faq.q: Does Sutra automatically detect comic panels?
faq.a: Sutra detects panel layouts on supported comic pages, but no detector is perfect for every artwork. Pages without detected panels remain available in full-page reading.
Panel Mode is available without a Pro purchase. File-format entitlements still apply: full CBZ and DRM-free MOBI reading require Pro, while EPUB and PDF reading are free.

faq.q: Can Sutra read manga right to left?
faq.a: Yes, Sutra offers right-to-left reading for supported content on iOS and Android.

faq.q: Can I read CBR comics or DRM-protected Kindle purchases?
faq.a: No. CBR archives and DRM-protected Kindle purchases are not supported. Sutra is for files you have the right to read without DRM.

faq.q: Can I try CBZ before buying Pro?
faq.a: A limited CBZ preview may be available. Full CBZ reading requires Sutra Pro; see the current app for its preview scope.
